6579/// Returns the index pointer for code point `code` in this index.
6580#[inline]
6581pub fn backward(code: u32) -> u16 {
6582    let offset = (code >> 4) as usize;
6583    let offset = if offset < 12190 {BACKWARD_TABLE_UPPER[offset] as usize} else {0};
6584    BACKWARD_TABLE_LOWER[offset + ((code & 15) as usize)]
6585}
